title: CATT: code and data release
description:
Code and per-item data for the paper CATT: Complexity-Aware Thinker-Talker Orchestration for Low-Latency Spoken Responses in Digital Humans. Includes the exact orchestration code of the main experiment (byte-identical to the frozen package, with checksums), the judge prompts and scripts, an analysis script that recomputes the main reported values (see README) from the released data, per-item records for the 738 evaluated items (per-turn metrics, judge labels, listening-rating scores, timelines, spoken text and reasoning), and per-item records of the transfer study on three hosted models. Benchmark items are not redistributed; GPQA Diamond and AIME texts, including model responses and reasoning on those items, are given as identifiers, metrics and hashes only.

Licences: the code is licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE); the data generated in this study are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA).
